notes: Independent critic review of the 24 delivered Part A facade PNGs. Read BRIEF-15 in full, earlier method sections in NOTES.md, and COURSE.md. Inspected all 24 at exact 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x; used 8x close-ups for ambiguous details. Inspected all 12 ground-floor facades in literal 3x3 repeats at 1x/4x, all 12 independently composed random stacks at 1x, representative stacks with four upper storeys at 4x, mixed wall-to-wall rows, and the three jetty neighbour pairs at 1x/4x. Compared against the supplied fantasy houses/halls, including native reference sheets. Ground repeats are facade repetition diagnostics, not terrain textures; ordinary repetition of a complete facade is not itself counted as a defect. All 24 pass exact N*48 by 48 dimensions, square exterior grid edges, binary alpha, zero hidden RGB, and a single connected opaque component. The 21 non-jetty panels are fully opaque; each jetty has 54 transparent pixels. No alpha fringe, haze/fog, magenta residue or detached alpha speck was found. Palette/pixel scale and top-left light are acceptable on the passing pieces. Each width is separately designed rather than a repeated w1. Course verification passes for every pixel: y=0 and y=47 both use (43,40,29,255) at x=0/W-1 and (98,66,38,255) at every interior x. All eight pieces of each width have identical complete RGBA rows. Vertical stacks have no transparent break at the contact rows. Passing this byte check does not cure the jetty holes above the course at lateral joins. Independently recomputed 110592 selected-source 8x8 RGBA mode blocks (7077888 samples), including lexicographic tie-breaking; all matched the saved mode stages. The recorded 5468 cleanup changes reconstruct all 24 final outputs exactly. Verified 108 literal ground-repeat placements and their exact 4x enlargements. Source paintings and processing records are consistent with the requested drawing/registration/mode/palette/cleanup method. Seasonal alpha overlays and seasonal-ground prop tests are not applicable: Part A names no seasonal partners, props or terrain tiles. Stacks and jetty joins were composited over the existing summer grass. Roofs, wall-end strips and colour variants belong to Part B and were not required or changed. This is an asset-composite review, not a live-game rendering test. No city15 file, COURSE.md, NOTES.md, reference, or neighbouring output was edited. Only this JSON and critic-r15A-1-*.png review composites were written.
